edges.description: The lab contains the post-FM-16 FM-17-pre protocol package as a bounded pre-execution research frontier; no ablation or runtime change is implied.
FM-13→FM-16 closed the generic-score/global-threshold question and exposed a residual qualification problem, which motivated the separate FM-17-pre structural-oracle diagnostic.
FM-17-pre is designed from the reconciled FM-16 failure modes and interpretation limits; the FM-16 closure remains controlling for what FM-16 actually established.
FM-17-pre is restricted to the frozen FM-16 run_007 evidence universe and must not silently broaden or relabel those executable artifacts.
The measurement charter defines the permitted scientific question, decision-state semantics, evidence universe, metrics and interpretation locks before execution.
The structural-oracle protocol specifies the exact offline mechanistic arms and preserves direct-answer, multi-hop component, related-context and nonanswer distinctions.
The annotation guide defines blinded oracle-label construction and anti-leakage rules if annotation is later explicitly authorized.
The frozen-input manifest locks the evidence universe to run_007 and prevents a future ablation from gaining signal through silent corpus or gold changes.
The STOP boundary is the action gate for the package: protocol/schema preparation is permitted, while annotation, ablation, runtime, architecture and product changes are not.
